cases.name: Oracle fixture order_ops package
cases.reason: The body from Fixtures/oracle/basic.sql keeps the member bodies the container fixture checks.

expected.limitation: boundary ambiguous (2 headers vs 1 catalog members)

cases.name: private overload defined before the public member
cases.reason: The body has two LOG headers for one catalog member; the private overload must not take the public member's body.

expected.limitation: boundary ambiguous (overload headers do not match catalog signatures)
boundary ambiguous (overload headers do not match catalog signatures)

cases.name: public overloads defined in reverse specification order
cases.reason: Header order differs from SUBPROGRAM_ID order, so positional pairing would swap the bodies.

cases.name: public overloads defined in specification order
cases.reason: Parameter modes, NOCOPY and defaults are not part of the compared type list.

expected.limitation: boundary ambiguous (overloads share a catalog signature)
boundary ambiguous (overloads share a catalog signature)

cases.name: overloads that differ only in parameter names
cases.reason: Equal type lists cannot confirm the definition order, so the specification-order members must not take each other's bodies.

cases.name: public forward declaration with an initialization block
cases.reason: PROCEDURE b; has no body, so it must not absorb a, b and the initialization block.

cases.name: local forward declaration inside a member
cases.reason: A local forward declaration must not close the enclosing member at the package END.

expected.limitation: 패키지 본문에서 멤버 경계를 못 찾음

cases.name: 100000 unterminated nested headers
cases.reason: Nesting beyond the depth limit has no certain boundary and must not exhaust the stack.

cases.name: IF statement before the next member
cases.reason: END IF closes the IF block; counting its IF as a new block made the member swallow b and the package END.

cases.name: FOR, WHILE and labeled loops before the next member
cases.reason: END LOOP, a lowercase end loop and END LOOP <label> close their loops without opening new blocks.

cases.name: CASE statements and CASE expressions
cases.reason: END CASE closes a CASE statement and a CASE expression closes with END alone; the LOOP right after a CASE expression in a FOR range opens the loop.

cases.name: local routine with control statements and an initialization block
cases.reason: Control statements inside a local routine and in the initialization block must not move the member boundaries.

description: Oracle PACKAGE BODY member attribution cases shared by probe-go/package_slices_test.go and probe PackageBodiesTest. Each expected entry is the exact trimmed member body or a substring of the limitation reason; repeat.text is appended repeat.count times to body.
